main_text.l: כְּסוּי tectus, tegmen, Pahul, Kal, vel No. f. m. Rad. כָּסָה texit.
כְּסוּף operiant te, Præt. Piel, 3. pl. aff. Rad. כָּסָה.
כְּסוּת tegumentum, כְּסוּתָהּ ejus, &c. No. sing. fæm. aff. Rad. כָּסָה.
כְּסִינוּ texerimus, præt. Piel, 1. pl. R. כָּסָה.
כְּסִיתָ texisti, כְּסִיתוֹ eum, כְּסִיתִי texi, &c. præt. Piel, 2. f. m. aff. & 1. f. Rad. כָּסָה.
כְּסָתְנִי operuit, כְּסָתְנִי me, pro כְּסָתַנִי, præt. Piel, 3. f. fæm. aff. ut & כְּסָתִי & כְּסָתִי texi, præt. Piel, 1. sing. Rad. כָּסָה.
כְּסָתוֹת pulvinaria, כְּסָתוֹתֵיהֶם eorum, No. pl. fæm. aff. Rad. כָּסָה vel, כָּסָת.
כַּעַם No. f. m. præf. R. כָּעַם indignatus fuit.
כָּעַשׁ sicut tinea, No. cum præf. R. עָשַׁשׁ depasci.
כַּף manus, cavum, curvatura, No. f. fæm. R. כָּפַף curvavit.
הַלּ־כַּף num incurvare ? Infin. Kal, præf. R. כָּפַף.
כַּפָּה ramus, כַּפָּהּ ejus, No. f f. aff. R. כָּפַף.
כַּפּוֹ manus ejus, כַּפָּה tua, כַּפִּי mea, &c. sing. fæm. כַּף, aff. Rad. כָּפַף.
כַּפּוֹת spathæ, plantæ, volæ, כַּפּוֹתָיו ejus, &c. No. pl. fæm. à f. fæm. כַּף, vel כַּפָּה, R. כָּפַף.
כַּפַּיִם manus, כַּפַּי meæ, כַּפָּיו suæ, כַּפֶּךָ tuæ, כַּפֵּיכֶם vestræ, כַּפָּיו eorum, &c. No. du. aff. à sing. כַּף, Rad.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and dagesh are reproduced from the scan at low resolution; the vowel marks in several Hebrew forms (e.g. כְּסוּף, כַּפָּהּ, כַּפֶּךָ) are doubtful. The Latin "præ" in the line beginning מִכַּעַשׂ is read as "pra" in the print and marked [?]. The Hebrew in "הַלּ־כַּף" is partly doubtful. The first Hebrew word of "כַּפּוֹ" and the form given as "tua" are uncertain. The running heads are Hebrew letters (כע left, כפ right) as printed. The right-hand page number is not visible on the scan.
